en: The postcard is a collage of four black-and-white photographic images. The upper left image shows a stately building with a sign reading 'Restaurant,' a horse-drawn carriage, and several people in front. The upper right image depicts a landscaped garden or courtyard, lined with trees, benches, and people strolling. The lower left image shows the interior of a large, elegant dining hall with many tables and chairs, decorated with hanging lights and curtains. The lower right image features a man sitting by a riverbank. The main printed text reads 'Gruß aus dem deutschen Herold, Moys' (Greetings from the German Herold, Moys). Handwritten text is also visible across the surface.
